CustomField.description: Whether this automation enforces a rule rather than providing a convenience, copied from the shipped registry. An automation marked this way cannot be switched off from the console or suppressed by a pause (ADR-0024).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Checked when the automation enforces a rule rather than providing a convenience. Its switch is shown off and disabled, and a pause does not suspend it.
CustomField.label: Always Runs
